news.title: Axies Ventures targets copper and gold opportunities
news.summary:
Axies Ventures Managing Director Jason Germiquet joined Steve Darling from Proactive to share news about the company's copper and gold exploration activities in Cyprus and Canada, its recent drilling campaign and its strategic priorities for 2027.

Following its recent listing in London, Axies Ventures is advancing its exploration portfolio through a systematic approach to geological development, historic data validation and targeted drilling.

Germiquet discussed the company's flagship Kokkinoantonis project in Cyprus, where a previous copper discovery returned an intersection of 72 metres at 0.5% copper, with additional gold and zinc mineralisation.

The company is also progressing exploration at its Petalas project, where a recently completed drilling campaign included twinning historic drill holes, infill drilling and step-out drilling. Samples are due to be shipped for laboratory analysis.

In Canada, Axies Ventures has completed fieldwork across three of its four projects. Germiquet highlighted the potential to expand its previously identified 1.5-kilometre copper zone in Ontario, where surface results reached 6.4% copper.

Looking ahead to 2027, the company is designing a follow-up diamond drilling programme at its flagship project while evaluating the potential of historic mine dump material estimated at between 8 million and 13 million tonnes.

Planned grid-based drilling, metallurgical testing and ongoing discussions with potential offtake partners form part of the company's priorities over the next 12 months, alongside continued exploration across its broader Cypriot and Canadian portfolios.
